title: Model configuration Pareto frontier
what: Number of Pareto-optimal configs (3) or accuracy/cost of key frontier points (cfg-mid-fp8 / cfg-large-bf16)

reader_questions.question: Which configurations define the Pareto frontier?
reader_questions.expected: Exactly 3 configs: cfg-mini-int4 (74.2%, $0.18), cfg-mid-fp8 (85.4%, $0.64), and cfg-large-bf16 (90.8%, $2.40).

reader_questions.question: Are the three frontier tiers separated beyond their evaluation s.d.?
reader_questions.expected: Yes, accuracy gaps (+11.2 pts and +5.4 pts) are well outside ±0.8–1.1 pt s.d.

reader_questions.question: What happens with the most expensive configuration (cfg-xl-bf16)?
reader_questions.expected: cfg-xl-bf16 ($3.90, 1180 ms, 89.4%) is strictly dominated by cfg-large-bf16 ($2.40, 790 ms, 90.8%).
